patterns.note: Full-bleed hero sections featuring high-quality video or photography, often with a dark overlay to ensure text legibility.
Prominent, large, and bold sans-serif headings are paired with smaller, clean body text and uppercase labels for navigation and section titles.
A high-contrast monochrome palette of deep blacks, dark greys, and off-whites is used for backgrounds and text, creating a sophisticated and modern feel.

The hero background image or video remains fixed or parallaxes subtly as the page content scrolls over it, creating depth. Sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport.
The primary navigation bar transforms upon scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid dark background while remaining sticky at the top of the page.
Product displays are organized into clean, responsive grids or horizontal carousels, often with a 'Shop now' call to action on each item.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-width background video or image that is either fixed or moves at a slower rate than the foreground content, achieving a parallax scrolling effect. Text and interactive elements are layered on top and scroll normally.

The global navigation bar is initially transparent and full-height. Upon scrolling past the hero section, it transitions to a reduced height and gains an opaque dark background, remaining fixed at the top of the viewport.

Content sections and individual product cards are introduced into view using scroll-triggered animations, typically a subtle fade-up or slide-in from the bottom, orchestrated with CSS keyframes as elements enter the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, clean body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are applied consistently to buttons, product cards, and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, while product grids maintain a more compact but still breathable layout.

standout: This site distinguishes itself with a premium, high-performance aesthetic achieved through the consistent use of full-bleed, dark-toned video and photography. The design feels less like a typical e-commerce site and more like a high-end editorial experience, emphasizing the product's advanced technology and athletic appeal.
